applicability_warning: CUAD contains commercial-contract review categories. A mapped label is retrieval or triage evidence only and cannot establish FAR or DFARS applicability.

termination_for_convenience.notes: Commercial termination-right language; not a FAR termination clause determination.

ip_ownership_assignment.notes: Useful for IP/data-rights triage; does not determine allocation under FAR or DFARS.

source_code_escrow.notes: Cyber-adjacent software custody signal, not a security-control finding.

uncapped_liability.notes: CUAD guidance includes some confidentiality-breach liability. This does not identify a confidentiality clause, cyber incident, CUI, or regulatory applicability.

insurance.notes: May support insurance triage; the CUAD label does not identify cyber coverage.
